title: Fix Demonstrator Logo And Title Navbar Alignment
description: Align demonstrator mainpage logo and title inside navbar instead of screen center, and ensure it appears in front of glass styling.
summary: Fixed demonstrator mainpage logo and title positioning and layer ordering. Root Cause: The logo and title on the demonstrator mainpage overview Chrome were rendered inside a screen-centered block (absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center) with a low z-index (z-20), causing it to sit behind the tint veil (z-30) and demonstrator grid cards (z-[31]). Fix: Updated DemonstratorLanding overviewChrome to render the logo and title using Navbar with centered: true inside a top-0 navbar container with z-40 (in front of the glass and veil layers).
